name: IPsec tunnel down (DPD teardown) + independent LAN-vantage probe loss: apps behind the tunnel unreachable, confirmed (dual-cloud fault lab drill C5)
comment: The gap the C5 tunnel-kill drill exposed: a raw IKE/DPD tunnel death with NO cloud config change cannot ground onto private-connectivity-down (which requires a cloud_change). The VPN gateway's own tunnel-state control-plane signal (observer ipsec:<gw>, INDEPENDENT of the cloud API) + an independent customer-path probe are two witnesses -> confirmed.
